master_process_map.title: Master manufacturing process map
master_process_map.caption: Projected material/assembly paths; intermediate operations are collapsed. Logic and memory are parallel branches. Detailed suppliers, recipes and Rubin applicability are not implied.

wafer_path.title: Raw materials to accepted wafer
wafer_path.caption: Representative chlorosilane/Siemens/CZ path at aggregate operation level; qualified output boundaries, not a complete recipe. FZ is documented separately in the crystal-growth chapter and entity register.

logic_path.title: Logic manufacturing path
logic_path.caption: Later-phase scope only. Design is an enabling input; detailed FEOL/MOL/BEOL and test steps remain to be researched.

hbm_path.title: HBM manufacturing path
hbm_path.caption: Later-phase scope only. Test/TSV/thinning are aggregated here; no universal sequence or proprietary recipe is asserted.

packaging_path.title: Packaging convergence
packaging_path.caption: Representative interposer-based assembly scope; tested logic, memory, substrate and interconnect structures converge. Other packaging architectures will have separate routes.

system_path.title: Package to rack integration
system_path.caption: Later-phase scope only. Board fabrication supplies module assembly; power and cooling are enabling integration inputs.

materials_map.title: Materials and their entry points
materials_map.caption: Materials and connected operations. Read evidence and route conditions before interpreting the diagram as a production sequence.

equipment_map.title: Equipment and process roles
equipment_map.caption: Machines connect to the operations they perform. Supplier lists are representative only where evidence is recorded.

supplier_map.title: Supplier relationships
supplier_map.caption: Company roles require evidence and claim IDs; they do not establish market share, exclusivity or Rubin design wins.

yield_map.title: Failure, detection and yield relationships
yield_map.caption: Failure modes, detection operations and measured characteristics; arrows do not represent an inevitable cascade.

economics_map.title: Manufacturing economics relationships
economics_map.caption: Only evidenced drivers are populated before Phase 10. Quantitative models and industry interpretation remain separate.

enabling_inputs.title: Enabling inputs and services
enabling_inputs.caption: Enabling inputs and evidenced supplier roles are distinct from physical conversion. Later-phase scopes remain planned.

oxide_pattern_transfer.title: Teaching oxide pattern transfer
oxide_pattern_transfer.caption: Illustrative positive-tone oxide pattern transfer only; no actual dimensions, qualified chemistry or universal device sequence implied.
